## Data Sync
**Purpose:** provide bootstrap, pull and idempotent push semantics for the React app.
**Input:** POST /webhook/pulse/sync.
**Output:** allowed collections only.
**Credentials:** production requires authentication.
**Dependencies:** workflow static data is a demo fallback; replace with the documented n8n Data Tables for shared production-like storage.
**Failure path:** rejects unknown actions/collections and caps collection sizes.

parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const action=String(body.action??'pull');const allowed=['incidents','riskZones','alerts','publications','historicalIncidents','aiSuggestions','roadStatus','confirmations','externalEvents','audit'];const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global');store.collections??={};for(const key of allowed)store.collections[key]??=[];const upsert=(key,record)=>{if(!record?.id)throw new Error('MISSING_EXTERNAL_ID');const list=store.collections[key];const index=list.findIndex((item)=>item.id===record.id);const normalized={...record,syncedAt:new Date().toISOString()};if(index>=0)list[index]={...list[index],...normalized};else list.unshift(normalized);store.collections[key]=list.slice(0,5000);return normalized;};try{if(action==='bootstrap'){const incoming=body.data??{};for(const key of allowed){if(Array.isArray(incoming[key]))for(const record of incoming[key].slice(0,5000))upsert(key,record);}return[{json:{ok:true,action,counts:Object.fromEntries(allowed.map((key)=>[key,store.collections[key].length])),generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];}if(action==='pull'){const requested=(Array.isArray(body.collections)?body.collections:allowed).filter((key)=>allowed.includes(key));const since=body.since?Date.parse(body.since):0;const data=Object.fromEntries(requested.map((key)=>[key,store.collections[key].filter((item)=>!since||Date.parse(item.updatedAt??item.createdAt??item.syncedAt??0)>since)]));return[{json:{ok:true,action,data,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];}if(action==='push_report')return[{json:{ok:true,action,data:upsert('incidents',body.report),generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];if(action==='push_confirmation')return[{json:{ok:true,action,data:upsert('confirmations',body.confirmation),generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];if(action==='push'){const key=String(body.collection??'');if(!allowed.includes(key))throw new Error('COLLECTION_NOT_ALLOWED');return[{json:{ok:true,action,collection:key,data:upsert(key,body.record),generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];}return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_ACTION',message:'Acción de sincronización no permitida.'}}}];}catch(error){return[{json:{ok:false,error:{code:String(error.message??'SYNC_ERROR'),message:'No se pudo sincronizar el registro.'}}}];}
